name: The Heptad (Haft Sirr / Seven Mysteries)
note: Attested in Spat and Kreyenbroek as the Seven Angels/Mysteries to whom Xwede entrusted the world; hub of Yazidi cosmology.

name: Xwede
dom: creation; transcendence; the remote One God
note: The single remote creator God in Yazidi belief who delegates the cosmos to the Heptad; attested across Kreyenbroek and Spat.

name: Tawusi Melek (Melek Taus, the Peacock Angel)
dom: chief of the Heptad; divine vicegerent; mediator
note: Chief of the Seven; venerated as God's foremost emanation and steward of the world. Yazidis REJECT the external misidentification with Shaytan/the devil; modeled here only as the Peacock Angel of the qewls (Spat, Kreyenbroek).

name: Sheikh Adi ibn Musafir
dom: reformer; manifestation of the divine; sheikhly lineage
note: Historical 12th-c. Sufi ascetic of Hakkari (d. c.1162) whose tomb is at Lalish; revered in Yazidism as a supreme manifestation and reorganizer of the faith (Kreyenbroek).

name: Sultan Ezid (Sultan Ezi)
dom: manifestation of the divine; eponymous holy figure
note: Revered manifestation/holy figure central to Yazidi devotion, often linked in name-tradition to the community's self-designation; attested in the qewls (Spat, Kreyenbroek).

name: Sheikh Hasan (Sheikh Sin)
dom: member of the Heptad; sheikhly lineage; scribe/wisdom associations
note: One of the Seven Mysteries and an earthly avatar; eponym of a principal sheikhly lineage (Kreyenbroek, Omarkhali).

name: Sheikh Shams (Shams al-Din)
dom: the sun; light; member of the Heptad
note: Member of the Seven associated with the sun and light; receives dawn veneration in Yazidi practice; eponym of a sheikhly lineage (Spat, Kreyenbroek).

name: Sheikh Fakhr al-Din
dom: member of the Heptad; cosmogonic/creative role
note: One of the Seven Mysteries, with a creative/cosmogonic role in the qewls; eponym of a sheikhly lineage. Distinct from the Sufi poet Fakhr al-Din Iraqi (homonym) (Kreyenbroek, Omarkhali).

name: Sheikh Sajadin (Sejadin)
dom: member of the Heptad; sheikhly lineage
note: One of the Seven Mysteries / Sons of Sheikh Adi's companions in the qewls; eponym of a sheikhly lineage (Kreyenbroek, Omarkhali).

name: Sheikh Nasirdin (Nasr al-Din)
dom: member of the Heptad; sheikhly lineage
note: One of the Seven Mysteries and eponym of a sheikhly lineage in the Yazidi oral tradition (Kreyenbroek, Omarkhali).

name: Sheikh Obekr (Abu Bakr)
dom: member of the Heptad; sheikhly lineage
note: Counted among the Seven Mysteries in several enumerations; eponym of a Yazidi sheikhly lineage (Kreyenbroek). Note: distinct from the Islamic caliph despite the shared name (homonym).

name: Lalish
dom: holy valley; pilgrimage center; cosmic axis
note: The sacred valley north of Mosul housing Sheikh Adi's tomb; supreme Yazidi pilgrimage site and a sanctified cosmic realm in the qewls (Spat, Kreyenbroek).

name: Pir Libnan (Pir Reshe / building master)
dom: sacred craft; building of Lalish; pir lineage
note: Holy figure of the pir caste associated in the qewls with the sacred construction at Lalish; eponym of a pir lineage (Kreyenbroek).

name: Pir Mehma Reshan
note: Revered pir-lineage holy figure of the Yazidi oral tradition, with storm/weather associations in some qewls (Omarkhali, Kreyenbroek).

name: Khatuna Fakhra
dom: midwifery; protection of mothers and children; revered woman
note: Venerated female holy figure invoked as a patroness of childbirth and protection of infants in Yazidi devotion (Spat).
